Subject: RE: Scaled growth bundling & prorate playbook (internal ops notes)

Internal notes for Sergio —

Summary answers you can share with Ava:

- Option 1 (Immediate top-up): The 10% uplift credit is a one-time billing credit applied to the prorated invoice for the remainder of the term. Sales Ops will apply it as a negative invoice line so their next statement shows the credit.

- Option 2 (Phased bundle): Conversion credits are applied retroactively when actuals exceed staged thresholds. If they accelerate beyond the schedule we perform a mid-period true-up and invoice the delta; any conversion credits reduce that true-up. This prevents double-billing while preserving predictable unit economics.

- Pricing tiers: Neither option changes the underlying per-token rates mid-term. Discounts are expressed as a blended commitment uplift (e.g., +2x commit => incremental discount percent). Any permanent change to base rates requires an amendment and Exec approval.

Suggested commercial levers to close:
- Approve up to 10% one-time credit for Option 1 (pre-approved by me for deals < $250k ARR incremental).
- Offer a 6–8% staged discount floor for Option 2 if they co-term to June 2027.

Attached: redwood_term_sheet.xlsx (annotated). Ben — can you run the invoice schedule for both options and paste the line-level sample? Priyom — tagging you for DocuSign template and PO acceptance checklist.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success & Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Samantha —

Thanks — quick recap and two formal options so procurement can pick: 

OPTION 1: Immediate Top-up (Fast lane)
- Bump committed capacity to +2x (effective immediately).
- Prorate remaining term through current renewal date; apply one-time 10% uplift credit as a negative invoice line.
- DocuSign link for the amendment: https://app.docusign.com/AVA-RDW-AMEND-1732 (sample; final to be sent after PO).
- Target timeline: PO this week => signed amendment and first proration invoice by 12/22.

OPTION 2: Phased Bundle (Smoothing lane)
- Stage uplift across two invoices over Q1 2027, apply conversion credits if actuals spike.
- Co-term set to June 30, 2027; we provide a 6% staged discount floor if co-term selected.
- No change to per-token base pricing; discount expressed as blended on top of committed units.

If you want, we’ll prepare the DocuSign for Option 1 based on your standard PO, or draft the co-term amendment for Option 2 and run the invoice schedule. Please let me know which path you prefer and confirm the PO owner at Ava so we can route the paperwork.
